When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend `CREATE_CASE` and `FILE_REPORT`, and `MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS` for every card that shares it.

case.summary: Transaction 3442910 for $150.09 on card C11309-K1 was flagged by automated monitoring due to high risk and model scores on a new device. Investigation identified device D007351, an Android Samsung device associated with fraud ring 34603052 and confirmed fraudulent in cases CC-5527 and CC-5533. During the same 48-hour window, the identical device was used to execute near-identical ~$150 purchases across two additional compromised cards, C01629-K1 and C07212-K2. The cardholder profile lacked any established legitimate history to explain this activity. The transaction is confirmed as card-not-present new device fraud, resulting in card blocking, case creation, connected card monitoring, and regulatory reporting.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details card-not-present fraud conducted on card C11309-K1 belonging to customer C11309, involving coordinated unauthorized online transactions linked to an organized fraud ring. On November 9, 2016, at 01:46:20 UTC, an unauthorized online transaction (ID 3442910) in the amount of $150.09 for product H was attempted in billing region 330 using a device newly associated with the account. The transaction utilized device D007351, identified by the user-agent profile SM-J327T1 Build/NRD90M running Android 7.0 with Chrome 65.0. Investigation revealed that device D007351 belongs to known fraud ring 34603052 and was previously confirmed fraudulent in closed bank cases CC-5527 and CC-5533. Internal graph intelligence established that the same device was concurrently utilized across multiple independent cards within a 48-hour window between November 8 and November 9, 2016. Specifically, connected card C01629-K1 incurred an identical charge of $150.06 on November 8, 2016, and connected card C07212-K2 incurred a $150.04 charge on November 9, 2016, just 42 minutes after the subject transaction. Card C11309-K1 has a history of prior compromise, including 20 historical confirmed fraud cases such as CC-5105 and CC-5221, with no prior legitimate transaction history established by the cardholder in region 330. The transaction was assigned a high model score of 0.729, corresponding to a calibrated fraud rate of 77.96%, alongside an elevated legacy risk score of 0.94. Total unauthorized exposure directly attributed to card C11309-K1 in this incident is $150.09. The bank has blocked card C11309-K1, initiated continuous monitoring on linked cards C01629-K1 and C07212-K2, and is filing this report due to multi-card compromise orchestrated through a confirmed fraudulent device ring.

stop_reason: The investigation was concluded pursuant to Policy Section 6 because the calculated fraud probability of 0.97 exceeds the decisive threshold of 0.85, corroborated by multiple independent incriminating findings across model scores, device history, and cross-card links, such that further investigative steps would not alter the final disposition.
